question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter exists, after the no-op pacing bug is fixed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but choosing pending recoverability over terminal failed entries changes upgrade and operator semantics for existing ambiguous delivery rows.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Pacing Fix
options.body: Merge after the no-op deferral pacing bug is fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter entries to remain recoverable until reconciliation ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the full delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a UI, doctor, or API surface that exposes deferred ambiguous rows before changing them to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Pacing Fix
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op deferral pacing bug is fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter entries to remain recoverable until reconciliation ships.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses persistent queue semantics, operator recovery behavior, and the SQLite delivery queue backing he recently migrated.
